// Build full HTML email const data = $input.first().json; const trackRows = data.trackTasks.map(t => ` ☐ ${t.task} ${t.time} ${t.note || ''} ` ).join(''); const personalRows = data.personalTasks.map(t => ` ☐ ${t.task} ${t.time} ${t.category || ''} ` ).join(''); const weekRows = data.weekPreview.map((d,i) => `
${d.day}
${d.date}
${d.type==='F'?'Free':'Work'}${d.isSat?' 📚':''}
` ).join(''); const dayColor = data.isSaturday ? '#7C3AED' : data.isFree ? '#16a34a' : '#dc2626'; const dayLabel = data.isSaturday ? 'DIPLOMA DAY' : data.isFree ? 'FREE DAY' : 'WORK DAY'; const html = `
Good morning, Loay
${data.today}
${dayLabel}

${data.dayMessage}

Next 7 days
${weekRows}
📘 Track tasks
${trackRows}
Task Time Note
🤲 Personal tasks
${personalRows}
Task Time Category
🕌 Prayer reminders today
${data.prayers.map(p=>`
${p.name}
${p.time}
`).join('')}

Verify exact times with your prayer app (Cairo times may shift daily)

72% success rate — you're building something real. Every day you study is a day closer to Jarvis.
Diploma 1 starts 11 Jul 2026 · Jarvis MVP: Jul 2027

`; return [{ json: { html, subject: `🌅 ${data.today} — ${data.isSaturday ? 'Diploma Day!' : data.isFree ? 'Free Day — Study Hard' : 'Work Day — Light Study Tonight'}` } }];
